name: Lesson 1 · Paddle, stand, pump
intro: Welcome to the line-up. Paddle into the wave, stand up, and find speed.

goals.hint: Paddle along the wave with ← → (stick), then press L or Y to stand as it lifts you
Hold ↑ (stick up) to pump. Pumping while dropping down the face gives the most speed

goals.label: Ride 20 s without wiping out
goals.hint: Trim mid-face with a neutral stick. Stalling (↓) lets the whitewater catch you
